calibration.basis: human (y=0) vs ai (y=1) samples only; score is a heuristic and is not expected to be calibrated until refitted.

gates.description: Labelled evaluation set of independently sourced samples, including human writing by non-native English writers (group name matching /non[-_ ]?native|esl|ell/i).
gates.threshold: >= 2000 samples total; >= 500 human and >= 500 ai; >= 200 human samples in a non-native group

gates.description: Discrimination between human and AI-generated text on held-out data not used to tune weights or thresholds.
gates.threshold: AUROC (human vs ai) >= 0.90, with >= 500 scored human and >= 500 scored ai samples
gates.observed: AUROC=1.0000 (held-out status must be attested by the G6 reviewer); not passable: requires >= 500 scored human and ai samples (have 4/4)

gates.description: False-positive rate on human-written samples at the operating threshold.
gates.threshold: FPR <= 1% and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 2%, with >= 500 scored human and ai samples
gates.observed: FPR=0.00% (0/4), Wilson upper 95%=48.99%; not passable: requires >= 500 scored human and ai samples (have 4/4)

gates.description: Ratio of the highest to lowest smoothed human FPR across subgroups with >= 100 human samples (at least 2 such groups required).
gates.threshold: max/min smoothed FPR <= 1.5 (ratio is 1 when no group has a false positive)
gates.observed: insufficient subgroup data (0 group(s) with >= 100 scored human samples)

gates.description: Expected calibration error of score vs observed AI rate (human vs ai samples, 10 equal-width bins).
gates.threshold: ECE <= 0.10, with >= 500 scored human and ai samples
gates.observed: ECE=0.2581; not passable: requires >= 500 scored human and ai samples (have 4/4)

gates.description: Independent reviewer (not on the implementing team) has reviewed the dataset provenance, held-out protocol and results.
gates.threshold: Signed reviewer record supplied (reviewer, organization, date, reference)

caveats: Metrics describe this dataset only; they are not evidence of accuracy on other populations or genres.
The harness cannot verify that the dataset is held out from tuning or independently sourced; that is the reviewer's responsibility (G6).
Samples that were not scored (too short / unsupported language) are excluded from AUROC, FPR and calibration.
Dataset has 12 samples; results have no evidentiary value for release decisions.
